jobs.excerpt: About FullscriptWe’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better.
jobs.description:
About Fullscript

We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.

That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.

We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.

This is your invitation.

Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.
Join us and shape the future of care.

The Opportunity

Fullscript offers co-op placements across a range of teams and functions. This general application is for students who are excited to gain hands-on experience, contribute to meaningful work, and explore where they can make the biggest impact during their placement.

Our teams work on high-impact projects that support practitioners, patients, and the overall Fullscript platform. Depending on the role and team, co-op students may contribute to product development, operations, data, design, customer experience, business functions, and more. You’ll have the chance to learn how work moves from idea to execution, collaborate with experienced teammates, and build practical skills in a fast-paced environment.

At Fullscript, co-op students are treated as real contributors from day one. You’ll gain meaningful hands-on experience, receive support and mentorship, and get exposure to how a growing company operates. If that sounds like your kind of environment, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a paid co-op opportunity open to students who are legally eligible to work full-time hours (approximately 40 hours per week) in Canada (preferably Ottawa, ON) for at least a 4 month term (Winter 2027). We’re looking for curious, motivated, dependable students who enjoy solving problems, learning quickly, and working with others to do great work.

What does a co-op student do here?

  • Contribute to real projects that support your team’s goals and priorities
  • Collaborate with teammates across functions and learn how work gets done in a growing company
  • Build practical skills through day-to-day experience, feedback, and mentorship
  • Participate in team meetings, planning, and shared problem-solving
  • Take ownership of assigned work and help move projects forward
  • Explore different areas of interest and gain broader exposure where possible
  • Take part in the full workplace experience, including onboarding, regular check-ins, mentorship, and learning opportunities

What you bring to the table

  • Currently pursuing post-secondary education, or recently completed a program, in a relevant area
  • Legally entitled to work full-time in Canada
  • A strong willingness to learn, take initiative, and contribute
    Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Comfort working in a team environment and adapting to new challenges
  • Previous co-op, internship, part-time work, volunteer, academic, or project experience is an asset

Bonus if you have

  • Experience working on team-based projects
  • Familiarity with tools, systems, or workflows related to your area of study
  • Experience in a fast-paced environment
  • Interest in healthcare, technology, or e-commerce
  • Curiosity about how different functions work together in a growing company

What we can offer you

  • Meaningful, hands-on experience with real impact
  • Mentorship, feedback, and support from experienced teammates
  • Opportunities to learn, grow, and build skills that carry into your career
  • A chance to connect with teams across the business and better understand where your interests fit
  • Participation in engaging company events and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility to work Wherever You Work Well

Compensation Range

The hourly rate for this role is $30/hour (CAD). Fullscript shares salary ranges to support transparency and help candidates make informed decisions. The range shown reflects base salary only. The range shown reflects base salary only. Additional incentives, perks, and benefits may be available as part of Fullscript’s total rewards package.

Final base salary depends on experience, skills, and location. We review pay regularly to stay aligned with market data and internal equity. Benefits and total rewards may vary by region.

Why Fullscript

Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. At Fullscript, we stay curious and keep finding smarter ways to make care better. We grow together, take on new challenges, and focus on impact. We put people first, work as a team, and leave egos at the door.

What to Know Before You Apply

We’re grateful for the interest in joining Fullscript. To make sure your application reaches our hiring team, please apply directly through our careers page.

A quick note: Due to the high volume of applications, we’re not able to respond to phone or email inquiries about application status. If there’s a match, our team will reach out directly.

Fullscript is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available upon request at .

All offers are contingent on successful background checks conducted in compliance with federal, state, and provincial laws.

We use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, including screening and reviewing responses. Final hiring decisions are always made by people and follow all applicable privacy and employment laws in Canada and the U.S.

Job Title: Junior Software Developer
Location: Remote, with occasional travel to U.S. Coast Guard in Kearneysville, WV

About VivSoft:
VivSoft is a mission-driven technology company specializing in Cloud, DevSecOps, Artificial Intelligence, and Digital Experience. We are a diverse team of innovators focused on creating open, scalable, and automated solutions that drive digital transformation in federal space. Our work culture fosters collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a Junior Software Developer to support the U.S. Coast Guard Command, Control, Communications, Computers, Cyber and Intelligence Service Center (C5ISC) under the COMPASS program. This role will support the development and sustainment of C5I-Home and VDS eStorefront, two Angular and Node.js web applications used to support Coast Guard operations and vessel documentation services.

The successful candidate will work as part of an Agile sprint team to develop enhancements, resolve defects, perform unit testing, participate in code reviews, and support releases across development, test, staging, and production environments. This is a hands-on software development role focused on consistent sprint execution, secure coding, application sustainment, and effective collaboration with senior engineers, QA teams, and Government stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, test, and maintain Angular front-end components and Node.js services for C5I-Home and VDS eStorefront.

  • Implement sprint-committed user stories, enhancements, defects, and maintenance tickets in accordance with defined acceptance criteria.

  • Support PostgreSQL data integrations and application interfaces with services such as Login.gov and Pay.gov.

  • Write clean, secure, maintainable, and documented code in accordance with program standards and OWASP secure coding guidance.

  • Identify and remediate application vulnerabilities identified through CI/CD and security scanning processes.

  • Write and maintain automated unit tests and support QA testing in development, test, and staging environments.

  • Assist senior engineers with troubleshooting production incidents, application defects, and performance issues.

  • Submit merge requests, participate in peer code reviews, and address review feedback.

  • Support deployment and promotion of application builds through development, test, staging, and production environments.

  • Ensure user-facing application functionality complies with Section 508 accessibility requirements.

  • Participate in daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

  • Maintain accurate work item status, estimates, implementation notes, and technical documentation.

  • Support monthly application maintenance releases and Government demonstrations and user acceptance testing.

  • Use Government-approved AI-assisted development tools to improve development productivity and code quality.

  • Provide occasional after-hours support for application releases and production incidents as required.

Required Qualifications:

  • 1-3 years of professional experience developing web applications.

  • Experience with Angular, React, Vue, or a similar modern front-end framework.

  • Proficiency with TypeScript or JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS.

  • Working knowledge of Node.js and developing or consuming RESTful APIs.

  • Experience working with relational databases and writing SQL queries.

  • Experience using Git-based version control and merge request or pull request-based code review workflows.

  • Experience writing and maintaining unit tests.

  • Familiarity with secure software development and secure coding principles.

  • Experience working in an Agile or Scrum software development environment.

  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.

  • Must be U.S. citizen.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a favorable DHS/U.S. Coast Guard suitability determination for a Moderate Risk Public Trust position (Tier 2 / SF-85P).

  • Ability to support core working hours of 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.

  • Ability to provide occasional after-hours support for production releases or incidents.

  • No degree required; relevant professional experience may be accepted in place of formal education.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • Hands-on experience with Angular and TypeScript, including component architecture, reactive forms, and RxJS.

  • Experience with PostgreSQL.

  • Experience with C#/.NET and Microsoft SQL Server.

  • Experience integrating applications with Login.gov, Pay.gov, or similar federal identity or payment services.

  • Experience with Jira, GitLab, Jenkins, or comparable Agile development and CI/CD tools.

  • Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker or OpenShift.

  • Experience supporting production applications in enterprise environments.

  • CompTIA Security+ CE or another DoD 8570/8140-aligned IAT Level II certification.

  • Existing DHS or U.S. Coast Guard suitability determination or active federal background investigation.

Benefits:

jobs.excerpt: ContexteParmi les 8 practices & bureaux de Wavestone, la business unit DC (Digital Customer) accompagne les entreprises françaises et internationales dans les secteurs du Luxe, Retail, Hospitality & Services.
jobs.description:
Contexte

Parmi les 8 practices & bureaux de Wavestone, la business unit DC (Digital Customer) accompagne les entreprises françaises et internationales dans les secteurs du Luxe, Retail, Hospitality & Services.

Notre objectif est d’aider nos clients à réussir les transformations majeures de leurs modèles de ventes et de livraisons de produits/services, notamment autour de quatre axes :

  • Digital Makers & Product Design
  • Retail Excellence
  • Supply Chain & Operations (SAP, PLM)
  • Intelligence Artificielle & Data

Forts de 250 consultant.e.s combinant des expertises sectorielles et technologiques uniques, nous sommes en capacité d’intervenir de bout en bout :

  • Sur l’ensemble de la chaine de valeur, de la vente aux opérations (finance, supply chain)
  • Sur l’ensemble des aspects métiers, fonctionnels, applicatifs et technologiques
  • De la stratégie au pilotage de la transformation, en préparant le futur modèle d’opération agile

Nous créons de la valeur de façon durable, grâce à notre Positive Way, en privilégiant toujours la simplicité et le pragmatisme.

Nous sommes indépendants, tout en entretenant de forts liens opérationnels avec les principaux leaders du marché pour rester en permanence à l’état de l’art. 

Dans un environnement où l’innovation technologique s’accélère, la capacité à transformer rapidement une idée en solution opérationnelle est devenue un enjeu stratégique pour les entreprises. L’essor des outils d’intelligence artificielle (IA) ouvre de nouvelles perspectives pour automatiser et accélérer le développement applicatif. Ces solutions promettent de réduire drastiquement le temps de conception et de mise en production, mais leurs performances réelles restent à évaluer.

Le stage s’inscrit dans cette dynamique : tester si les outils IA disponibles fin 2025 permettent de passer efficacement de l’idée à une application web déployable en production, et dans quelle mesure ils peuvent se substituer aux approches traditionnelles ou low-code.

Objectif du stage

Encadré.e par un.e chef.fe de projet expérimenté.e, vous aurez pour mission de réaliser un benchmark opérationnel des solutions IA orientées développement applicatif. Ce benchmark se déroulera en deux étapes :

  • Analyse théorique : étude comparative des principales solutions du marché (fonctionnalités, interopérabilité, coûts, contraintes techniques).
  • Expérimentation pratique : sélection de 4 solutions pour concevoir et développer une application web avec chacune d’elles. L’application réalisée sera choisie en fonction des besoins internes ou d’avant-vente (exemple : outil support pour un événement, maquette fonctionnelle pour un projet). Outre le développement, ce sera aussi l’occasion de mettre à l’épreuve / développer vos compétences UX

À l’issue de ces travaux, vous produirez une analyse critique de la qualité du code généré, des performances et de la facilité de déploiement, afin de formuler des recommandations concrètes sur les meilleures solutions à adopter.

Une question complémentaire pourra être explorée : les solutions IA peuvent-elles remplacer les plateformes low-code en termes de rapidité, sécurité et intégration dans un SI d’entreprise ?

En bref, l’objectif est d’avoir développé à l’issu du stage une compréhension fine de comment l’IA permet d’être efficient dans le développement informatique, et une conviction sur les meilleurs outils à utiliser.

En parallèle, vous serez pleinement intégré.e à la vie interne du cabinet et pourrez contribuer, selon vos appétences, à :

  • L’animation et le développement des offres de l’expertise Supply Chain ;
  • La rédaction de contenus à destination de nos blogs et supports de communication ;
  • Le développement de nos assets internes (Shake'Up, CréaDesk, Research & Knowledge Center) ;
  • Les initiatives de recrutement, de relations écoles et de formation ;
  • La mise en œuvre de la stratégie RSE de Wavestone.

Travaux à réaliser

Le ou la stagiaire contribuera activement à l’enrichissement de l’offre interne de Wavestone autour de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel :

  1. Réaliser un état des lieux du marché : identification des solutions IA orientées développement web, analyse de leurs caractéristiques et positionnement.
  2. Élaborer un benchmark théorique : comparaison des avantages et limites des solutions (rapidité, qualité du code, interopérabilité avec outils comme Figma, coût).
  3. Sélectionner 4 solutions et développer une application web avec chacune : mise en œuvre concrète pour tester la capacité à passer de l’idée à la production.
  4. Évaluer la qualité des livrables : analyse du code généré, robustesse, maintenabilité, sécurité et facilité de déploiement.
  5. Produire un rapport de recommandations : synthèse des résultats, classement des solutions et propositions pour leur usage futur.
  6. Optionnel : définir un cadre permettant d’intégrer ces solutions IA dans une stratégie de remplacement ou complément des outils low-code.

Étudiant.e au sein d'une grande école d'ingénieurs avec une spécialisation en ingénierie logicielle, vous êtes attiré.e par le conseil et vous possédez une forte appétence pour les sujets de transformation digitale au sein d’entreprises leaders de leur secteur.

Vous souhaitez développer des compétences liées au métier du conseil et aux problématiques de transformation des organisations, tout en conservant un pied solidement ancré dans les sujets de développement informatique.

Vos atouts :

  • Doté.e d’une véritable appétence pour les sujets techniques, vous avez des connaissances en développement et maîtrisez les bases de l’algorithmie
  • « Expérimenter », « entreprendre », « innover » sont des mots importants pour vous ; avoir réalisé un projet de dév en dehors du cadre des cours sera un bonus appréciable
  • Orientation client, excellent relationnel et sens du service seront des atouts importants pour cadrer les spécifications des applications à réaliser ; justifier de connaissances en UX serait un plus
  • Enfin, précision, rigueur, organisation, autonomie et esprit de synthèse seront autant de qualificatifs appréciés pour mener à bien ce stage

Par ailleurs, vous voulez être acteur.rice d'un projet d'entreprise ambitieux en pleine croissance en France et à l'international. Vous avez envie de mettre votre enthousiasme au service d'un cabinet qui saura vous proposer une prise de responsabilités rapide.

Wavestone est un employeur inclusif qui s'engage pour l'égalité des chances. Dans le cadre de cette politique de diversité et inclusion, Wavestone accompagne les personnes en situation de handicap et/ou nécessitant un aménagement durant leur process de recrutement et tout au long de leur prise de poste.

Rejoignez un cabinet de conseil international qui accompagne les grandes transformations stratégiques.

Nous sommes Wavestone : des expert·es passionné·es et orienté·es solutions, qui placent l’humain au cœur de la performance et de la croissance. Ambitieux·ses et en pleine expansion, nous développons sans cesse notre portefeuille de clients et de projets, avec une portée internationale et une réelle volonté de générer un impact positif.

Êtes-vous un vrai team player, porté par des valeurs fortes ? Êtes-vous curieux·se et déterminé·e, avec l’envie d’apprendre chaque jour ? Êtes-vous du genre à relever les défis sans hésiter ? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit. Rejoignez Wavestone et exprimez votre potentiel dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif, où l’on transforme les défis d’aujourd’hui en opportunités de demain.

jobs.excerpt: About the Mission TerraByte Green is a non-profit startup based in North Carolina, focused on the intersection of digital equity and environmental sustainability.
jobs.description:
About the Mission
TerraByte Green is a non-profit startup based in North Carolina, focused on the intersection of digital equity and environmental sustainability. We manage e-waste responsibly by refurbishing technology to bridge the digital divide.

The Big Picture
This is a fully remote internship, though candidates based in North Carolina, especially those local to our operating area, are preferred. You will work directly with our Founder and CEO and closely with our AI Curriculum Intern to maintain and grow our website and online course platform. This is a hands on opportunity to build real web management and LMS administration experience.

What You Will Do

  • Maintain and update the TerraByte Green website, built on WordPress

  • Manage and organize course content on our LearnPress powered course platform

  • Work closely with the AI Curriculum Intern to publish and structure new course material

  • Troubleshoot and fix small site issues as they arise

  • Support general site improvements and organization over time

Why This Opportunity Matters

  • You get real, portfolio ready web management and LMS experience

  • You will have direct ownership over the digital front door of a mission driven organization

  • You will build skills in WordPress administration, content organization, and LMS management, all of which transfer directly to future roles

  • You will receive mentorship, a letter of recommendation or reference, and networking opportunities within the nonprofit and tech space

  • Strong performance may lead to future paid opportunities as TerraByte Green grows

Compensation
This is an unpaid internship. Our priority is giving you real experience, mentorship, and professional material you can use to grow your career, with the goal of transitioning capable interns into paid roles as the organization's revenue grows.

Requirements & Onboarding

  • North Carolina residency preferred, open to fully remote candidates

  • Commitment of 5 to 10 hours per week for a 3 month internship

  • Basic familiarity with WordPress helpful but not required. We are looking for reliability and curiosity over existing skill

  • Reports directly to the Founder and CEO

Internship Disclaimer
This is an unpaid volunteer internship with TerraByte Green, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. There is no compensation, wage, or salary associated with this role, and no expectation of compensation, express or implied, is created by this posting or by any communication during the application or internship process. The internship is structured for the primary benefit of the intern, providing training, mentorship, and hands on experience comparable to what would be gained in an educational setting, rather than to fill a role that would otherwise be performed by paid staff. The internship duration is limited to the period defined at the start of the engagement (3 months), reflecting the period in which the intern receives meaningful educational and professional benefit. Acceptance of this internship does not create any express or implied entitlement to future paid employment with TerraByte Green, though capable interns may be considered for future paid roles as organizational funding allows. Applicants must be authorized to volunteer in the United States.
